data.other_hard: Have one of the listed Black or Mixed Black ethnicity categories; Have a confirmed place to study a first undergraduate degree at the University of Cambridge due to commence October 2026; Assessed for UK 'home' fee status; Applied to Student Finance and received confirmed financial support, with an income assessment completed
data.evidence_sentence: The Stormzy Scholarship supports Black UK students studying any undergraduate course at Cambridge.
data.notes: Page text is outdated: it says applications for 2026 are now closed and refers to 2026-27 figures and October 2026 entry, while today is 2026-11-21. No future deadline is stated; applications are said to open in August. The UK requirement is home fee status, not citizenship, so ONLY:UK is an approximation. Nationality is not stated directly.
